articles.title: Jezek to Retire from 426th District Court Thursday
articles.excerpt: Gov. Rick Perry appointed her in 2007, the year the court was created, and she took her oath in February 2007 (Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: Three Republicans Vying for 426th District Court Judgeship
